feat: add .mts and .cts config files to default search places (#368)

https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/modules/reference.html#module-format-detection

The default loaders have mapped .mts and .cts to loadJs/loadJsSync
since the switch to Node's native type stripping, but no search-place
list included those filenames, so search-based resolution (the way
stylelint, commitlint and most other consumers use cosmiconfig) never
found them. Only an explicit load('foo.mts') worked.

Add .{name}rc.{cts,mts}, the .config/ subdirectory variants and
{name}.config.{cts,mts} to the default searchPlaces, and the
config.{cts,mts} forms to the global and meta search places. The
synchronous API only gains the .cts forms: .mts files are ECMAScript
modules and cannot be loaded synchronously, mirroring the existing
.mjs exclusion.

Also update the README extension lists and fix the stale loader table
that still documented the removed loadTs/loadTsSync loaders.
